summary: Kimbell Royalty Partners, LP filed an 8-K announcing the completed acquisition of mineral and royalty interests in the Permian Basin from Mesa Visa Royalties and related sellers. Total consideration was ~$44M cash plus 6.929M OpCo common units and an equal number of Class B units exchangeable for Kimbell common units. No board recommendation or advisor named. The registration rights agreement covering common units issuable upon exchange suggests overhang management. Watch for share dilution drag and any purchase price adjustments; risk-arb focus is on post-close unit exchange mechanics.
